value.answer: Mostly overrated, for me. It's well made and third-party tested, and if it replaces a multivitamin, a probiotic and a couple of other supplements, it can earn its keep. But reviewers who checked the doses found many ingredients below effective amounts, and I couldn't find independent clinical evidence for the benefit claims. It runs about $89 a month on subscription or $112 for a one-time box, so you're paying a lot for that. Only worth it if the convenience is what you're after.
